docs.title: BHI-Research Group
docs.text:
We are a multidisciplinary research group at Universidad Tecnológica Nacional, Facultad Regional Bahía Blanca, Argentina. We work on Computer Vision, Machine Learning, and High Performance Computing, with a focus on AI that runs on everyday hardware such as a personal computer.

docs.title: pico-JEPA v2: When Do Many Small Models Beat One Big Model?
docs.text:
Original title: pico-JEPA v2: ¿Cuándo Superan Muchos Modelos Pequeños a Uno Grande?

A. Rostagno, J. Iparraguirre, R. Briatore, A. González, S. Aggio. CACIC 2026, XXXII Congreso Argentino de Ciencias de la Computación, Concepción del Uruguay, Entre Ríos, Argentina, October 2026.

Instead of training one model on all the data, we train several tiny models (about 3.4 million parameters each) on separate slices and combine their predictions. When the small models are diverse and a learned meta-model combines them, the group beats the single model by +5.1 percentage points on a 30-class video classification task. The advantage disappears if each model is too small or there are too few classes.

docs.title: pico-JEPA: Understanding Video with Ultra-Light Models and Collective Wisdom
docs.text:
Original title: pico-JEPA: Comprendiendo el Video con Modelos Ultra-Ligeros y la Sabiduría Colectiva

A. Rostagno, J. Iparraguirre, G. Friedrich, S. Aggio, R. Briatore, L. Tobio, D. Coca. CACIC 2025, XXXI Congreso Argentino de Ciencias de la Computación, Viedma, Argentina, October 2025.

A very small video model that learns without labels, combined with a voting scheme across several copies of the model to make its classifications more accurate and robust.

Paper (ES) Code

docs.title: nano-JEPA: Democratizing Video Understanding with Personal Computers
docs.text:
A. Rostagno, J. Iparraguirre, J. Ermantraut, L. Tobio, S. Foissac, S. Aggio, G. Friedrich. WASI 2024, XXV Workshop Agentes y Sistemas Inteligentes, CACIC 2024.

A scaled-down version of a video JEPA model that can be trained and run on a personal computer instead of a large GPU cluster.
